questions.q: The main objective of the West African Clearing House (WACH) is to:
options: regulate the production and sale of crude oil in West Africa
provide military assistance and security to member states
promote the use of local currencies for intra-regional trade settlements
fix the prices of agricultural export commodities globally
questions.explain: The **West African Clearing House (WACH)**, which later transitioned into the West African Monetary Agency (WAMA), was set up to facilitate payments for intra-regional trade using member countries' local currencies, thereby conserving scarce foreign exchange reserves.
